name: human_tennis_ball_cup_take3 (forces derived), in the demonstrator's palm frame

object.mass_note: ASSUMED 0.0577 kg (ITF tennis-ball spec midpoint) for the derived forces only; not measured in the demo

frame.note: the model hand's frame (tools/build_human_hand.py --measured): wrist at the origin, x toward the thumb, y distal, z palmar; per-frame rigid fit of the observed wrist and knuckles
frame.gravity: varies per frame (the derived forces carry it)

notes: contact = George's ruled contacts (25 Oct): break = lift above resting level or return sweep
station_pos = pad point: tip joint moved toward the ball centre by the provisional pad offset [8.1, 8.9, 8.7, 9.2, 4.9] mm (thumb..little); null when the tip has no three-camera position
contact_point = ball centre + radius x unit(tip - centre); contact_normal = into the ball
obj_quat (w,x,y,z): ball orientation relative to the first frame, chained from ink-mark flow
